title: Zebra eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- zebra stripes on body -->
  <path d='M32 52 Q38 58 34 68 Q36 72 40 74' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 48 Q48 56 45 66 Q47 72 50 76' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 48 Q60 56 57 66 Q59 72 62 76' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 52 Q70 58 68 68 Q70 72 72 74' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='72' width='6' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <rect x='42' y='75' width='6' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#ececec'/>
  <rect x='55' y='75' width='6' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <rect x='63' y='72' width='6' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='#ececec'/>
  <!-- leg stripes -->
  <line x1='33' y1='79' x2='39' y2='79' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='82' x2='48' y2='82' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='82' x2='60' y2='82' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='79' x2='69' y2='79' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='33' y='86' width='6' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#b0a8d8'/>
  <rect x='42' y='87' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#b0a8d8'/>
  <rect x='55' y='87' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#b0a8d8'/>
  <rect x='63' y='86' width='6' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#b0a8d8'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M28 57 Q20 46 22 36 L32 34 Q30 48 36 52 Z' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- neck stripes -->
  <path d='M26 54 Q24 48 24 42' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 50 Q28 44 27 38' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='32' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M30 24 Q28 18 31 14 Q34 18 33 24 Q36 20 39 18 Q38 23 36 28' fill='#8b7bd8'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='21' rx='3.5' ry='6' fill='#f2f2f2' transform='rotate(20 32 21)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='21' rx='1.8' ry='3.5' fill='#d8d0f0' transform='rotate(20 32 21)'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#4a3a8a'/>
  <circle cx='20.8' cy='29.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='36' rx='5.5' ry='4' fill='#e0d8f0'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='36' r='1.2' fill='#8b7bd8'/>
  <!-- mouth open eating -->
  <path d='M11 39 Q14 42 18 40' stroke='#8b7bd8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: apple being eaten -->
  <circle cx='11' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ff9a9a'/>
  <path d='M11 37.5 Q12 35 14 35' stroke='#4ad86a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='34.5' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#4ad86a' transform='rotate(-20 14 34.5)'/>
  <!-- bite mark on apple -->
  <path d='M14 40 Q16 42 15 44' stroke='#e04444' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 55 Q80 50 82 56 Q84 60 80 62' stroke='#6a5acd' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#8b7bd8'/>
  <!-- sparkles around -->
  <path d='M86 36 L88 32 L90 36 L94 38 L90 40 L88 44 L86 40 L82 38 Z' fill='#ffd95a'/>
  <path d='M8 22 L9 19 L10 22 L13 23 L10 24 L9 27 L8 24 L5 23 Z' fill='#ffd95a'/>
</svg>
